 From Ethan Klein To Charli D’Amelio, Trisha Paytas Keeps Predicting The Future — So Now People Are Convinced She’s Actually A Witch
 Whatever Trisha’s next prediction is, we’re going to need everyone to pay very close attention.
 Posted on Oct 27, 2026 UTC comment 
 Facebook 
 Pinterest 
 Link 
 by Mariam Sharia BuzzFeed Contributor 
 At this point, someone might want to check whether Trisha Paytas has a crystal ball hidden somewhere in her house. 
 Alberto Rodriguez / Getty Images
 Over the years, the internet personality has made plenty of outrageous statements about celebrities, influencers, and even the British royal family . But lately, fans have been revisiting old clips of Paytas and noticing some peculiarities. Namely, how well her seemingly random remarks have aged. 
 Tap to play GIF 
 Tap to play GIF
 blndsundoll4mj/YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 This has fueled one of the internet's favorite conspiracy theories: that Trisha Paytas might be a witch. 
 @maxxytrillion / X.com / Via x.com 
 Trisha seemingly predicted Ethan Klein's cheating scandal six years ago. Her former Frenemies co-host (and brother-in-law by marriage) is currently facing the fallout from allegations that he was unfaithful to his wife, Hila Klein, who revealed that he had been having an affair for more than six months. 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 The allegations prompted the H3 Podcast to announce an "indefinite hiatus," and several cast members said they would be parting ways with Klein. 
 @h3_podcast / Instagram / Via instagram.com 
 1. 
 As the scandal unfolded, fans pulled an exchange between Klein and Paytas from an October 2020 episode of Frenemies , in which the latter suggests that Klein may have missed out on the experience of being single while enjoying fame. "I feel/lowkey wish you could be single while you're famous and rich because I feel like you didn't get that out of your system," she told him. 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "Don't you wish you could date now that you're known and have money? Don't you think you missed out a little bit? Yes, you do! It's fine!" she said to Klein. "I'm not interested in that," Klein replied. "I'm very happily married...but I'm saying, yeah, it would be fun to know what it's like to date when you actually have something going for you." 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 2. 
 In another resurfaced clip , Paytas acknowledges the tension between Klein and his father-in-law. "Her dad, he didn't like me," Klein said of Hila's father. "He thought I was crazy." He added, addressing Paytas: "And you're, like, way crazier than I am." 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "Am I, though?" Paytas asked. "I think so, yeah," Klein replied. "Hmm, interesting," Paytas said, grinning.
 Fans are treating the resurfaced exchange as another example of Paytas clocking a detail others may have overlooked. Caption text over the fan edit reads, "Ethan Klein being a cheater was not on my 2026 bingo card. Trisha saw Ethan's future in this moment." 
 koobifighting / X / Via x.com 
 3. 
 In another clip from March 2020, Paytas brought up allegations of infidelity involving Ethan's father, with viewers drawing parallels between the two situations. "I subconsciously make myself as unattractive as possible because of my dad, because he's such a creep and weirdo, and I don't want female attention because I don't— because I want to be true to you," Klein said to his wife Hila as Paytas watched, "and faithful to you, and I don't want other women to be attracted to me." 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "Can you imagine if I f***** your dad? That'd be crazy," Paytas said. "He probably would," Klein replied. "Has he been unfaithful?" asked Paytas. "I probably shouldn't even talk about that," replied Klein. 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 It's worth emphasizing that the clip does not establish any truth to the allegations about Klein's father. Still, Paytas discussing infidelity in Klein's family years before his own marriage became the subject of cheating allegations struck fans as an odd coincidence.
 4. 
 Perhaps the most brutal clip fans have resurfaced includes Paytas telling Klein that he "has no other options." At the time, it came off as an exchange between two podcast hosts with a famously contentious relationship. 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 Now, viewers are interpreting the remark as yet another example of Paytas's foresight, with one X user calling her the "immortal snail of the internet." 
 @BraedenBurge / X.com / Via x.com 
 "I can see why your relationships don't work out," Klein told Paytas in a clip from 2021. "I can see why you've been with the same person for 12 years," Paytas replied. "You have no other options. And quite frankly, I don't blame you." 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "I don't care if Moses breaks up with me over this, bye," Trisha said, invoking her husband, Moses Hacmon, who is the brother of Ethan's wife, Hila. 
 JC Olivera / Getty Images
 "Why would Moses break up over a podcast?" Klein asked his sister-in-law. "Because I don't like his family," Paytas said. "And I don't like hanging out with you guys, and you guys are awful, and that's it. And yeah, I said it." 
 H3 Podcast / YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "But you liked me when we started," Klein said. "No. I was trying to be nice and fun. But I actually don't really care that much for you." 
 "Really, you never liked me?" Klein asked. "No," responded Paytas.
 "It’s crazy how she’s always right about a lot of things," wrote one viewer on a TikTok clip of the exchange. "Honestly might start believing in psychics…" replied OP. 
 @katycxo / Via tiktok.com 
 "genuinely think Trisha Paytas is the most impressive witch of our generation," one X user wrote of the situation. 
 @kikikatsune / X.com / Via x.com 
 5. 
 Paytas had also questioned the way Charli and Dixie D'Amelio's parents were managing their careers long before the family's affairs became public discourse. In 2021, Paytas posted a video from her car drinking "The Charli" drink from Dunkin' while saying , "I hope her parents aren't stealing that money. I really really hope not. I hope you're, like, putting it aside for her, 'cause they just, like, love that limelight." 
 @blndsundoll4mj/YouTube / Via youtube.com 
 "I fear my intuition is too strong," Paytas commented on the TikTok at the time. 
 @trishapaytas/TikTok
 Fast-forward to 2026, and the D'Amelio family is facing public allegations involving family finances and relationship rifts after gossip blog DeuxMoi shared a post in May alleging that Marc and Heidi D'Amelio transferred "millions of dollars out of accounts that were established during the years [Charli's] career was managed by her parents." 
 Dia Dipasupil / Getty Images
 "No, they're not true," Charli told the Hollywood Reporter  earlier this month about the rumors concerning her parents. "I wouldn’t say that they stole my money," she said. "I think we did a lot of things as a family.”
 Her father responded to the DeuxMoi post, writing: "This is not true. We love Charli, but she is being manipulated, and I have the receipts," before  taking to TikTok  to say, "She hasn’t reached out to me in some time. She's mad at me for something."
 "Ethan cheating the same year Charli D'Amelia [sic] makes it obvious she had to cut off her family bc they were exploiting her (just as Trisha predicted would happen) like. Her mind," wrote one X user. 
 @fetalgeniuss / X.com / Via x.com 
 6. 
 Of course, no discussion of Paytas's supernatural abilities would be complete without mentioning the reincarnation conspiracy theories surrounding her children. It all began on Sept. 7, 2022, when Paytas shared that she was one centimeter dilated during her first pregnancy. 
 Gilbert Flores / Getty Images
 The very next day, Queen Elizabeth II died at the age of 96. 
 @trishapaytas / X.com / Via x.com 
 The coincidence sent the internet into a frenzy as fans joked that the late queen was about to be reincarnated as Paytas's baby. 
 @ih8petewentz / X.com / Via x.com 
 The only problem was that Paytas hadn't actually given birth. She addressed the rumors on Sept. 9 in a video, clarifying that she was still pregnant. She gave birth to her daughter Malibu Barbie, on Sept. 14, 2022. 
 @trishlikefish88 / TikTok / Via tiktok.com 
 7. 
 But the reincarnation theories didn't stop there. The same thing happened during her second pregnancy in 2024 when King Charles III announced he had cancer. 
 @erar97 / X.com / Via x.com 
 He survived, and Paytas gave birth to her daughter, Elvis , in May of that year. 
 AARON CHOWN / Getty Images
 8. And then did it once again on July 22, 2025, when Paytas announced she'd given birth to her son Aquaman 10 days earlier... 
 Trisha paytas is 3 for 3 omg… pic.twitter.com/L9kJivNoCX 
— welp. (@YSLONIKA) July 22, 2025 
 @YSLONIKA / X.com / Via x.com 
 ...and news broke that very day that legendary rocker Ozzy Osbourne had died at 76. 
 Scott Dudelson / Getty Images
 9. 
 Then, in April 2025, Pope Francis died while Paytas was pregnant with her third child, and — you guessed it! — the internet immediately revived the theory. 
 @user2917489540/X / Via http://www. x.com 
 "I just don’t get it," Paytas said of this particular rumor on her Just Trish podcast that month. "First of all, I’m months away from my due date, not even close this time." 
 Alberto Rodriguez/GA / Getty Images
 Obviously, the reincarnation "theories" are more of an ongoing internet bit and meme at this point, and Paytas herself has pushed back on them, posting a video with the song "Crazy Train" by Osbourne alongside the caption "my baby is just a baby y'all" after the latest round of jokes. 
 @trishlikefish88 / X.com / Via tiktok.com 
 Maybe the real question isn't whether Trisha Paytas can predict the future, but why nobody believes her until it's too late.
